scope: Live top-level explicit function source facts; constrained/inferred/qualified/impl/native declarations remain explicit unsupported cases.
decisions: Two attached type nodes mean input/result; a single declared type is the result of a no-input function. Inferred result flag32 is not silently replaced.
Stream metadata exposes Unit as return and declared result annotation as stream element; async flag8 is independent of public/ownership bits.
Input and additional parameter records consume shared owned/named-owned type plans. Exclude synthetic input/block aliases that reuse function AST.
Legacy cache generic facts include first three source generic names, even when a fourth is present. Constraint facts must not be assumed absent if a where clause exists.
Effects follow return annotation in the actual parser and retain raw identifier spelling, sorted ordinal UTF16 with duplicates preserved. Bodies are never scanned for effect-like identifiers.
Null callback/stream/generic slots preserve the exact managed empty-string contract; absent associated impl map is valid only for a plain top-level function.
